uncertainties: Every listed section was checked. An empty issues array indicates no issue found; a nonempty array indicates issues found.

No occurrence-to-card link map was supplied. Link actions specify required bindings where existing labels differ from the relevant occurrences; unmatched labels alone were not treated as proof of failure.
The p057 grouped cards already explain all individual Horae, Moirai, and Charites. They need no additional identity text provided those group cards remain reachable.
Night at 726–727 combines personification with a spatial darkness image; its explanation should preserve both rather than assert a separate physical action by an Olympian goddess.
Literal earth, sky, sun, seasons, desire, quarrels, and upper air were not automatically treated as additional divine names. Triton in v929 is explicitly a river, distinct from the sea god in p059.
